does_not: It does not predict prices or tell you to buy. The pre-registered backtest came out inconclusive, and the gate-passing rows did worse than the rest over 6 months.
It does not trade, hold funds or connect a wallet. Nothing on the page places an order.
It does not show tick-by-tick prices. Numbers come from the last audited snapshot, collected every 6 hours and pushed to open pages the moment it passes its audits.
It never publishes a snapshot that fails an audit. It keeps the last one that passed and dates it.
It does not rank by trust, float or unlocks. Those are tags, never part of the order.
It covers only tokenized projects that DeFiLlama tracks.

The Chart score is a reading of a chart, not advice and not a forecast. On the Chart Analyzer's held-out data, high scores did not rise more often. It is read from DEX pool candles, which the analyzer's study did not measure, and it never sorts, filters or picks anything.
The Altseason panel does not forecast. It compares this week with the 2018 and 2021 altseason ends, and it does not score AI questions, web traffic or new stablecoins.
